column1: # World-class thresholds — FAIL CI on HIGH; MEDIUM treated as fail via report parser
# Only ignore alerts meaningless on plain HTTP localhost DAST
# HSTS only applies to HTTPS terminators — ignore on http://127.0.0.1
# Security headers MUST be present (we set them — fail if ZAP still flags HIGH elsewhere)
# Injection / XSS / command — always HIGH fail
# CSRF on state-changing without token — MEDIUM
